def test_carts_management():
    customer_id = f"cust_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}"

    # Get a sock
    resp = requests.get(get_url("catalogue", "/catalogue"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    sock = resp.json()[0]
    item_id = sock["id"]
    unit_price = sock["price"]

    # Add item
    item_payload = {
        "itemId": item_id,
        "quantity": 2,
        "unitPrice": unit_price
    }
    resp = requests.post(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{customer_id}/items"), json=item_payload, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 201, f"Expected 201, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    # Verify item
    resp = requests.get(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{customer_id}/items"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    items = resp.json()
    assert len(items) == 1
    assert items[0]["itemId"] == item_id
    assert items[0]["quantity"] == 2

    # Update item
    update_payload = {
        "itemId": item_id,
        "quantity": 5,
        "unitPrice": unit_price
    }
    resp = requests.patch(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{customer_id}/items"), json=update_payload, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 202, f"Expected 202, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    # Verify update
    resp = requests.get(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{customer_id}/items/{item_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    assert resp.json()["quantity"] == 5

    # Delete item
    resp = requests.delete(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{customer_id}/items/{item_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 202, f"Expected 202, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    # Verify delete
    resp = requests.get(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{customer_id}/items/{item_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 404, f"Expected 404, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    # Delete cart
    resp = requests.delete(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{customer_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 202, f"Expected 202, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    # Verify cart deleted
    resp = requests.get(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{customer_id}/items"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    assert len(resp.json()) == 0

def test_carts_merge():
    customer_id = f"cust_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}"
    session_id = f"sess_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}"

    # Get a sock
    resp = requests.get(get_url("catalogue", "/catalogue"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    sock = resp.json()[0]

    # Add to session cart
    item_payload = {
        "itemId": sock["id"],
        "quantity": 1,
        "unitPrice": sock["price"]
    }
    resp = requests.post(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{session_id}/items"), json=item_payload, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 201, f"Expected 201, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    # Merge
    resp = requests.get(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{customer_id}/merge?sessionId={session_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 202, f"Expected 202, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    # Verify customer cart
    resp = requests.get(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{customer_id}/items"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    items = resp.json()
    assert len(items) == 1
    assert items[0]["itemId"] == sock["id"]

    # Merge non-existent -> 404
    resp = requests.get(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{customer_id}/merge?sessionId=nonexistent_session"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 404, f"Expected 404, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

def test_payment_http_authorization():
    order_id = str(uuid.uuid4())

    payment_payload = {
        "address": {
            "city": "London",
            "country": "UK",
            "number": "10",
            "postcode": "EC1A",
            "street": "Street"
        },
        "amount": 50.0,
        "card": {
            "ccv": "999",
            "expires": "12/26",
            "longNum": "1111222233334444"
        },
        "customer": {
            "firstName": "Jane",
            "lastName": "Doe"
        },
        "orderId": order_id
    }

    # Authorize payment
    resp = requests.post(get_url("payment-http", "/payments"), json=payment_payload, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    auth = resp.json()
    assert auth.get("authorised") is True

    # Verify authorization
    resp = requests.get(get_url("payment-http", f"/payments/{order_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    auths = resp.json()
    assert len(auths) == 1
    assert auths[0].get("authorised") is True

    # Invalid amount -> declined
    payment_payload["amount"] = 150.0
    resp = requests.post(get_url("payment-http", "/payments"), json=payment_payload, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    auth = resp.json()
    assert auth.get("authorised") is False

    # Verify both
    resp = requests.get(get_url("payment-http", f"/payments/{order_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    auths = resp.json()
    assert len(auths) == 2
    assert auths[0].get("authorised") is True
    assert auths[1].get("authorised") is False

def test_orders_end_to_end_workflow():
    username = f"user_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}"

    # Register
    user_payload = {
        "username": username,
        "password": "pwd",
        "email": f"{username}@example.com",
        "firstName": "Jane",
        "lastName": "Doe"
    }
    resp = requests.post(get_url("user", "/register"), json=user_payload, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    # Add Address
    address_payload = {
        "city": "London",
        "country": "UK",
        "number": "10",
        "postcode": "EC1A",
        "street": "Street",
        "userID": username
    }
    resp = requests.post(get_url("user", "/addresses"), json=address_payload, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    address_id = resp.json().get("id")

    # Add Card
    card_payload = {
        "ccv": "999",
        "expires": "12/26",
        "longNum": "1111222233334444",
        "userID": username
    }
    resp = requests.post(get_url("user", "/cards"), json=card_payload, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    card_id = resp.json().get("id")

    # Get product
    resp = requests.get(get_url("catalogue", "/catalogue"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    sock = resp.json()[0]

    # Add to cart
    item_payload = {
        "itemId": sock["id"],
        "quantity": 3,
        "unitPrice": sock["price"]
    }
    resp = requests.post(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{username}/items"), json=item_payload, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 201, f"Expected 201, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    # Place Order
    order_payload = {
        "customer": f"/customers/{username}",
        "address": f"/addresses/{address_id}",
        "card": f"/cards/{card_id}",
        "items": f"/carts/{username}/items"
    }
    resp = requests.post(get_url("orders", "/orders"), json=order_payload, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 201, f"Expected 201, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    order = resp.json()
    order_id = order.get("id")
    assert order_id is not None

    # Verify Order via GET
    resp = requests.get(get_url("orders", f"/orders/{order_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    assert resp.json().get("id") == order_id

    # Verify Order in Customer search
    resp = requests.get(get_url("orders", f"/orders/search/customerId?custId={username}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    customer_orders = resp.json().get("_embedded", {}).get("customerOrders", [])
    assert any(o.get("id") == order_id for o in customer_orders)

    # Verify Payment Authorization
    resp = requests.get(get_url("payment-http", f"/payments/{order_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    auths = resp.json()
    assert len(auths) > 0
    assert auths[-1].get("orderId") == order_id
    assert auths[-1].get("authorised") is True

    # Verify Shipment
    resp = requests.get(get_url("shipping-http", f"/shipping/{order_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    shipment = resp.json()
    assert shipment.get("orderId") == order_id

def test_user_registration_and_profile_management():
    username = f"user_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}"
    password = "password123"
    email = f"{username}@example.com"

    user_payload = {
        "username": username,
        "password": password,
        "email": email,
        "firstName": "John",
        "lastName": "Doe"
    }

    # Register
    resp = requests.post(get_url("user", "/register"), json=user_payload, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    # Follow-up GET: verify customer exists
    resp = requests.get(get_url("user", f"/customers/{username}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    assert resp.json().get("username") == username

    # Register again -> 409 Conflict
    resp = requests.post(get_url("user", "/register"), json=user_payload, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 409, f"Expected 409, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    # Login
    resp = requests.get(get_url("user", "/login"), auth=(username, password), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    # Add Address
    address_payload = {
        "city": "New York",
        "country": "USA",
        "number": "123",
        "postcode": "10001",
        "street": "Broadway",
        "userID": username
    }
    resp = requests.post(get_url("user", "/addresses"), json=address_payload, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    address_id = resp.json().get("id")
    assert address_id is not None

    # Verify address added
    resp = requests.get(get_url("user", f"/customers/{username}/addresses"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    addresses = resp.json().get("_embedded", {}).get("address", [])
    assert any(a.get("id") == address_id for a in addresses)

    # Add Card
    card_payload = {
        "ccv": "123",
        "expires": "12/25",
        "longNum": "1234567890123456",
        "userID": username
    }
    resp = requests.post(get_url("user", "/cards"), json=card_payload, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    card_id = resp.json().get("id")
    assert card_id is not None

    # Verify card added
    resp = requests.get(get_url("user", f"/customers/{username}/cards"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    cards = resp.json().get("_embedded", {}).get("card", [])
    assert any(c.get("id") == card_id for c in cards)
    card_obj = next(c for c in cards if c.get("id") == card_id)
    assert "*" in card_obj.get("longNum")

    # Delete Address
    resp = requests.delete(get_url("user", f"/addresses/{address_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    # Verify address deleted
    resp = requests.get(get_url("user", f"/customers/{username}/addresses"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    addresses = resp.json().get("_embedded", {}).get("address", [])
    assert not any(a.get("id") == address_id for a in addresses)

    # Delete Card
    resp = requests.delete(get_url("user", f"/cards/{card_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    # Verify card deleted
    resp = requests.get(get_url("user", f"/customers/{username}/cards"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    cards = resp.json().get("_embedded", {}).get("card", [])
    assert not any(c.get("id") == card_id for c in cards)

    # Delete Customer
    resp = requests.delete(get_url("user", f"/customers/{username}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    assert resp.json().get("status") is True

    # Verify customer deleted (spec says it yields empty customer with only username)
    resp = requests.get(get_url("user", f"/customers/{username}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    customer = resp.json()
    assert customer.get("username") == username
    assert customer.get("firstName") is None
